contact_sources.quote: Home / People / James Charrington Chair, Supervisory Board James Charrington Member of the Management Committee James chairs our Supervisory Board, advising the senior partner and partnership around all aspects of firm strategy. James was most recently a Senior Advisor at BlackRock and the Non-Executive Chairman of BlackRock Group Limited, the primary operating entity of BlackRock EMEA. Prior to this, James held a number of senior executive positions within BlackRock servicing as Head of BlackRock EMEA and as a member of BlackRock’s Global Executive Committee and Global Operating Committee. He originally joined Mercury Asset Management in 1993.
